description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'makeOpenAIChatCompletionRequest' that interacts with the OpenAI API to perform chat completions with streaming support. It handles request setup, response streaming, content processing, and callback invocation for various events such as image generation, search results, and usage metrics.

methods.name: makeOpenAIChatCompletionRequest
methods.description: Performs a streaming chat completion request to OpenAI API, processes streamed chunks, and triggers callbacks for content, images, reasoning, search results, and usage data.
